title: Isolation of PBMC and Plasma from Whole Peripheral Blood
author: Jennifer L. Dembinski
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jtmcnk6
materials: Miloje Savic and Jennifer L. Dembinski
Peripheral blood sample collection tubes (ACD/yellow top tubes)
For more details see Stemcell Sepmate Protocol:
Slowly add 10 mL of prewarmed AIM-V medium.

steps.title: Prepare Materials and Environment
steps.instruction: Ensure all work is performed under sterile conditions, ideally in a laminar flow class II biosafety cabinet. Bring the blood sample, saline, density gradient medium, and centrifuge to room temperature (15 - 25°C).

steps.title: Prepare SepMate-50 Tube
steps.instruction: Add 15 mL of density gradient medium (e.g. Ficoll, Sigma-Aldrich) to the SepMate-50 tube by carefully pipetting it through the central hole of the SepMate-50 insert.

steps.title: Dilute Blood Sample
steps.instruction: Dilute the blood sample with an equal volume of saline in a separate 50ml tube and mix gently.

steps.title: Load Sample and Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Add the diluted sample to the SepMate-50 tube by pipetting it down the side while keeping the tube vertical. Centrifuge at 1200 x g for 10 minutes at room temperature (15 - 25°C) with the brake on.

steps.title: Collect Plasma
steps.instruction: Collect 3ml of plasma from the very top layer of the SepMate-50 tube using a pipette. Aliquot into 1ml per cryovial tube and store at -20°C.

steps.title: Isolate and Wash PBMCs
steps.instruction: Pour the top layer containing enriched PBMCs into a new 50ml tube (do not hold the tube inverted for longer than 5 seconds). Wash the cells to remove Ficoll.

substeps.instruction: Fill the 50ml tube with warm AIM-V media.
Centrifuge at 1200 x g for 10 minutes.
Repeat this washing procedure 2 more times.

steps.title: Prepare Freeze Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare freeze medium consisting of 65% AIM-V, 25% FBS, and 10% DMSO. Label cryogenic vials with date, cell type, and user’s initials.

steps.title: Cryopreserve PBMCs
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet and prepare for freezing.

substeps.instruction: Suction away supernatant from centrifuged PBMC and add freeze medium.
Count PBMC and adjust volume to 5 million cells/ml freezing media.
Quickly aliquot 1 mL of cells in freeze medium per cryogenic vial and screw closed.
Place vials in a Mr. Frosty freezing container and store at -80°C with a 1°C/min cooling rate.
The next day, transfer vials to a liquid N2 tank or -150°C freezer for long-term storage.

steps.title: Thaw Cells
steps.instruction: Rapidly thaw the cell vial in a 37°C water bath until only a small ice pellet remains.

substeps.instruction: Spray the vial with 70% ethanol, wipe, and place into a laminar flow class II biosafety cabinet.
Pipet the contents of the vial (~ 1 mL) into a T15ml tube.

steps.title: Wash and Count Thawed Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the thawed cells and determine the final cell count.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend cells in fresh 10ml AIM-V.
Centrifuge again at 300 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 1ml of AIM-V and count the cells.

steps.title: Adjust Cell Concentration
steps.instruction: Adjust the cell count per ml of media according to the requirements of the desired downstream protocol (e.g., ELISpot, flow cytometry, in vitro assays).
